summary.name: EdrawMax
summary.one_liner: EdrawMax is a diagramming tool for creating flowcharts, org charts, infographics, Gantt charts, P&ID and many other diagram types, with AI features for generating and analyzing diagrams.
use_cases: collaborating on diagrams with a team
summary.what_it_does: EdrawMax is a diagram editor that the page says supports over 280 diagram types in its meta description, while the body text cites 210 types of diagram solutions. It offers a Microsoft-like interface, drag-and-drop editing, and professional template resources, with more than 1,500 built-in templates and over 26,000 symbols. AI features are described for generating diagrams, analyzing diagrams, transforming styles, generating images, and creating stickers and icons. Users can share and collaborate on their work in various file formats.
notable: Over 200 diagram types with 1,500+ built-in templates and 26,000+ symbols
AI tools for generating, analyzing, restyling diagrams and creating icons and images
Online community for inspiration and sharing
caveats: Page does not state pricing or whether any features require a paid tier
Diagram type count differs between meta description (280) and body text (210)
